description:
Applies a workflow map to a base material, and generates height information as well as PBR channels for the result.
The height input must be connected to a Create Map or Mix Maps node. The other inputs must be connected to a base material.
The outputs must be connected to the Mix or the Output node, or a workflow filter node.

inputs.label: Albedo
inputs.name: mat1

inputs.description: The ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic channels of the input material
inputs.label: ORM
inputs.name: mat2

inputs.description: The emission channel of the input material
inputs.label: Emission
inputs.name: mat3

inputs.description: The normal map of the input material
inputs.label: Normal
